instruction:
Treat /home/user/Desktop/cli_plate.step in FreeCAD 0.21.2 Path/CAM as the starting point. To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). Use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for FreeCAD Path command-line automation when working on `cli_plate.step`.

Create one Path/CAM Job whose stock matches the imported solid with no added stock extension, and set the work coordinate origin at the stock top-face center. In the source STEP coordinates that origin is (0, 0, 18) mm, so the requested final physical top at source Z=10.000 mm is WCS Z=-8.000 mm. Create exactly one active top Face operation using T1, defined as a face mill, with clockwise spindle S6000 rpm and horizontal cutting feed F750 mm/min. Generate the paths with FreeCAD and export the Job through FreeCAD's LinuxCNC postprocessor. Save both the native Job document and the posted program at exactly /home/user/Desktop/task-01.FCStd and /home/user/Desktop/task-01.nc.
